---

## Brand Positioning
WPCarePoint is a UK Web Development, eCommerce & AI Solutions Agency.
Tagline: Building, improving and supporting digital businesses.

We focus on practical WordPress engineering and WooCommerce storefronts alongside modern React, Next.js, and TypeScript builds, bounded business workflow automation, structured website care, and technical SEO and AI search readiness.

All engagements follow four core principles:
1. Full client ownership of domains, code repositories, hosting accounts, and content.
2. Clean semantic architecture and responsive layouts engineered around WCAG 2.2 Level AA accessibility clarity.
3. Responsible technology use aligned with UK GDPR and PECR boundaries and human approval checkpoints.
4. Direct, written engineering scoping without sales queues or multi-layer handoffs.

## Five Core Service Categories

### 1. Website Design & Development
- URL: https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/website-development/
- Focus: Custom WordPress block themes (Gutenberg) without heavy page-builder bloat, plus React, Next.js, and TypeScript frontend applications.
- Standards: Mobile-first responsive UI, WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility clarity, clean semantic HTML, and controlled single-hop 301 migration hygiene.

### 2. eCommerce Development
- URL: https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/ecommerce-development/
- Focus: WooCommerce (including High-Performance Order Storage — HPOS) and tailored online retail platforms built for UK merchants.
- Standards: GBP (£) pricing, UK VAT tax rules, Stripe and Apple Pay with Strong Customer Authentication (3D Secure / SCA), Royal Mail and DPD shipping configuration, and clean product Schema markup.

### 3. AI & Business Automation
- URL: https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/ai-business-automation/
- Focus: Practical automation linking website enquiries, CRM records, accounting tools, and internal operations.
- Standards: Least-privilege server-side API integrations, human-in-the-loop approval checkpoints, UK GDPR data minimisation, and audit-friendly workflows.

### 4. Website Care & Technical Support
- URL: https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/website-care-support/
- Focus: Structured website stewardship across three tiers (**Essential Care**, **Advanced Care**, and **Elite Care** — all **Enquire for Pricing**) plus a standalone **WordPress Quick Fix** pathway (`https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/website-care-support/#one-off-fixes`).
- Standards: Off-site encrypted backups in UK/EEA infrastructure, staging-first updates before production deployment, uptime monitoring, security hardening, and direct email scoping with honest written terms rather than unverified SLA claims.

### 5. SEO & AI Search Optimisation
- URL: https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/ai-search-optimisation/
- Focus: Technical SEO, search experience clarity (SXO), and consolidated AI Search Optimisation (GEO & AIO) so UK organisations are represented accurately in Google UK, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.
- Standards: Verified Schema.org JSON-LD entity graphs, clean crawl structure, factual copy aligned to visible page content, and crawler governance (`robots.txt` and `/llms.txt`).

## Supporting & Specialist Services

### WordPress Speed Optimisation
- URL: https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/wordpress-speed-optimisation/
- Focus: Diagnostic performance engineering addressing Core Web Vitals, image compression and WebP/AVIF formats, caching, render-blocking scripts, WordPress database autoload bloat, and UK hosting bottlenecks without misleading score guarantees.

### Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- URL: https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/search-engine-optimisation/
- Focus: Independent technical SEO foundations including crawl hierarchy, semantic markup, canonical discipline, 301 migration protection, and UK regional relevance.

### Custom Web Solutions & Integrations
- URL: https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/custom-web-solutions-integrations/
- Focus: Bespoke website modules, interactive TypeScript/React interfaces, and reliable REST API or webhook connections linking forms, CRMs, and operations software.

### AI-Powered Website Development
- URL: https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/ai-powered-website-development/
- Focus: Scoped interactive website intelligence, grounded knowledge retrieval, and guided user qualification tools designed with privacy boundaries and human oversight.

### Branding & Brand Identity
- URL: https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/branding-brand-identity/
- Focus: Visual identity systems, WCAG 2.2 AA colour contrast tokens, clean typography scales, and practical digital design consistency.

### Digital Marketing & Online Growth
- URL: https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/digital-marketing-online-growth/
- Focus: Conversion-focused landing page architecture, organic visibility alignment, and privacy-respecting measurement principles without fabricated traffic or lead guarantees.

## Working Process & Commercial Transparency
1. **Discovery & Technical Audit**: Inspect business goals, existing website structure, hosting environment, speed bottlenecks, and integration needs in writing.
2. **Design & Staging Architecture**: Build and review page hierarchy, visual components, WooCommerce configuration, or automation pipelines in an isolated staging environment.
3. **QA, Speed & Launch Governance**: Test responsive layouts across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints, verify accessibility contrast, SSL, canonical tags, and 301 redirects prior to controlled cut-over.
4. **Ongoing Care & Search Growth**: Support live websites with structured Care Plans, speed tuning, and iterative SEO and AI Search improvements where agreed.

All pricing, Care Plan tiers, and project quotes are scoped clearly in writing after technical review via `contact@wpcarepoint.co.uk`.
